info.name: Rodha Mobile Verification & Soft Block
info.description:
Student mobile verification OTP (Azmarq) + soft-block messaging for Website and Rodha Buddy.

**Captured from local DB/API** (`localhost:5000`, student `mobile.verify.docs@rodha.local`).

Use environment **Rodha Local** (`{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:5000/rodha/`).

**Run order:** 00 Auth → 01 Admin settings → 02 Student OTP → 03 Me / popup → 04 Soft-block & errors.

**FE docs:** `docs/FE_MOBILE_VERIFICATION_WEBSITE.md`, `docs/FE_MOBILE_VERIFICATION_BUDDY.md`.

**Gate priority:** email → mobile → registration.

response.name: 200 — student login (mobile.verify.docs@rodha.local)
200 — OTP sent (not written to users.mobile yet)
400 — mobile locked after verify
409 — already verified on another account
429 — too many active OTPs
200 — popup window (required, not overdue)
